interface.name: unity_preview_manager_v1
interface.description: Draws live windows into surfaces of the client. The client places, sizes, orders and synchronizes those surfaces with standard requests (wl_subsurface, wp_viewport); the compositor only draws the window.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: the surface is not a subsurface

request.name: get_preview

description.summary: draw a window into a surface

request.description: The surface must have the wl_subsurface role. The compositor scales the window so that its frame fills the surface, and draws it above the surface's own content, clipped to the parent surface. The window's client-side shadow draws around the surface. Drawing starts after the parent surface commits the subsurface, and follows the surface's mapped state: attach a null buffer to hide the window, attach a buffer to show it again. If the window does not exist, is not mapped, or unmaps later, the surface shows nothing more.

arg.name: view_id
arg.summary: wayfire view id of the window
